mechanism: Tiered durable project memory (working, episodic, long-term) with drift detection, repair and compaction in an agent operating layer
evidence_scope: Covenant exposes three memory tiers and a drift discipline over them.
evidence_role: We describe Covenant, an open operating layer that exposes eight primitives—intent, run- time, memory, identity, permissions, comms, compositor, settlement—behind a local Rust daemon
